title: Session stop leaves no tile summary; dual restart buttons; restart not auto
body:
John 2026-07-28 (workbench / project dashboard stop of live general session):

Leave other sessions alone for now. Restart quality is disappointing.

What happened:
- Stopping a session did not put the tile up with a summary so I could tell what we had been working on.
- Agent later found context from dig/archaeology — but if I had been trying to start an earlier session I do not think it would have found it or restarted properly.
- When a session is stopped it should have: a session-specific ID, a human summary, and restart file/material.
- Then there should only be ONE restart button when the session window starts back up (right now there are two).
- Restart should be automatic — do not just load a prompt and ask me to hit Enter; the restart path should send/continue as part of restart.

Cross-links: docs/friction/2026-07-25-SLEEP-INTAKE-restart-and-dictation.md Defect 1; docs/friction/2026-07-25-restart-handoff-quality.md. This report adds: missing board tile on stop, dual restart controls, and auto-continue (no manual Enter).

Success criteria for sleep:
1. On graceful stop/close/park: immediately write session-specific ID + plain-English summary + durable RESTART/HANDOFF material onto MAIN (survives worktree eviction).
2. Board/workbench tile shows that summary within seconds — scannable goal/status/next — not empty or transcript-filename-only.
3. Resume UI: exactly ONE restart/continue control (not two).
4. Choosing restart (or auto-resume path) starts the engine AND injects/sends the resume seed so the agent begins work without the human pressing Enter.
5. Earlier sessions remain findable/restartable by their session ID + tile summary, not only the latest dig.
